brief:
Fayez Abu Amneh works in a sunlit Bethlehem workshop, shaping raw wood into artistic pieces as he navigates economic pressures facing Palestinian artisans, the Palestine News Network reported. Abu Amneh studies the natural contours, knots, and imperfections in each block of wood before beginning his sculpting process.

The artisan's work reflects broader struggles within Palestinian communities to sustain traditional crafts amid economic constraints.
dek: BETHLEHEM / West Bank — Inside a sunlit workshop in Bethlehem, Fayez Abu Amneh runs his hands over a rugged, asymmetrical block of raw wood, studying its natural contours, knots, and imperfections.
title: Palestinian wood sculptor fights economic hardship through craft
